title: Privacy Policy
introduction: Privacy Policy For The Website And The Games Of TaleVerse:

sections.body:
At TaleVerse, protecting user privacy is one of our core commitments. We are dedicated to providing a safe, creative, and enjoyable experience across our games and applications. This Privacy Policy explains how information is collected, used, stored, and protected when you use a TaleVerse product or service. By accessing or using any TaleVerse game, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.
Our mission is to create immersive, story-driven experiences that allow players to enjoy meaningful adventures without requiring unnecessary personal information. We aim to minimize data collection and only process information that is necessary to operate, maintain, improve, and secure our services. We are committed to maintaining a responsible environment that respects both player privacy and user trust.

sections.heading: Advertisements and Premium Content
sections.body:
TaleVerse uses a structured monetization system that includes in-game advertisements and optional premium content. This system is designed to support the ongoing development of the Game while ensuring that the core narrative experience remains fully accessible to all players.
Advertisements are an integrated part of the Game experience and may appear during gameplay. Ads help support the ongoing development, maintenance, hosting, and updates of the Game.
Advertisements may be served by third-party advertising networks, which may process limited technical and non-personal data to display and optimize ad content. Such processing is governed by the privacy policies of the respective providers.
TaleVerse does not directly collect or share personally identifiable information for advertising purposes. Any data used in relation to advertising is handled automatically by external systems and is not accessible in a way that identifies individual users.
In addition to advertisements, the Game may include optional premium content. Premium features are strictly optional and do not affect the player’s ability to access or complete the main narrative.
Premium content may include:
-Ad removal for an uninterrupted gameplay experience
-Additional narrative paths, side stories, or expanded lore that enhance the world but are not required to complete the main story All premium content is optional and designed only to enhance the overall experience without affecting core gameplay progression.
All payments related to premium content are handled securely through external payment systems. TaleVerse does not collect, store, or process any financial information.
The monetization system is designed to balance sustainability with accessibility, ensuring that all players can fully experience the main story regardless of purchase decisions.

sections.heading: Data Collection, Storage, and Third-Party Services
sections.body:
TaleVerse follows a strict minimal and purpose-driven approach to data collection. The application only collects and processes information that is necessary for limited gameplay functionality, technical operations, and maintaining a stable user experience. The goal is to ensure that the Game remains fully playable while maintaining a strong commitment to user privacy and data protection.
During normal use of the application, TaleVerse may collect and store a limited set of user-provided and system-generated information. This may include the player’s chosen username, selected in-game preferences such as gender selection when used for character setup within the Game, and a randomly generated unique player identifier used internally to support system functionality and distinguish user sessions.
This information is used exclusively for gameplay-related purposes, including enabling core game features, maintaining consistency within the user experience, and ensuring that the application functions correctly. It is not collected for advertising, profiling, or marketing purposes.
TaleVerse utilizes Firebase, a cloud-based platform provided by Google LLC, as its backend infrastructure. Firebase is used for both secure data storage and essential technical services required for the operation of the Game.
The data stored in Firebase includes gameplay-related information such as username, gender selection (when applicable), and story progression. This data is used strictly to support core gameplay functionality, including saving player progress, restoring game state across sessions, and maintaining continuity of the narrative experience.
For more information about how Firebase handles data, users may refer to the official Firebase Privacy & Security documentation:
https://firebase.google.com/support/privacy
TaleVerse does not intentionally collect sensitive personal information such as full legal names, email addresses, phone numbers, physical addresses, precise location data, financial information, or government-issued identification numbers. The Game is designed to function without requiring such sensitive data.
All collected information is strictly limited to what is necessary for gameplay functionality, technical support, and maintaining application stability. It is never sold, rented, shared, or used for advertising, marketing, or profiling purposes.
Where applicable, data may be processed in aggregated or anonymized form solely for the purpose of improving system stability and resolving technical issues. This processing is performed in a way that does not attempt to identify individual users.
TaleVerse is committed to minimizing data usage, maintaining transparency, and ensuring that users retain a high level of privacy while interacting with the Game. All data handling practices are designed to prioritize functionality, stability, and user trust.

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.body:
The security of player information is a fundamental priority for TaleVerse. All data stored through Firebase is protected using Google’s cloud infrastructure, which includes industry-standard security measures designed to help safeguard data against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.
Access to stored data is restricted to authorized members of the TaleVerse development team and is granted only for legitimate purposes such as technical maintenance, troubleshooting, and improving application stability. This access is limited and monitored to ensure responsible handling of all stored information.
TaleVerse is designed with privacy and security in mind, following a minimal data collection approach that reduces potential exposure risks by only collecting information that is necessary for core gameplay functionality and technical operation.
No unnecessary personal data is collected, and all user interactions remain within the application environment. This reduces dependency on external systems and helps maintain a controlled and secure data ecosystem.
While TaleVerse implements internal security practices and relies on Firebase’s built-in protections, users are also encouraged to maintain good device-level security practices, such as using screen locks, secure device settings, and regular backups where applicable.
This combined approach helps ensure a balanced environment where functionality, stability, and responsible data handling are maintained without compromising user privacy.
